steps.content: [WhiteSands - Night]
The desert night wind is bitingly cold. The piteous townsfolk of Tuco have nowhere to flee, and can only hide in rocky crevices.
A wounded Wright is surrounded by many townsfolk, his face devoid of color. Many are injured. Some are crying, and some are quietly comforting others.
Hella can't hear anything clearly. She sits away from the crowd, head down, face buried in her knees.
Someone comes over and sits next to Hella. Without speaking, she places a cup of hot milk down, then silently treats Hella's wounds.
The wound on her ear is almost healed, with only some half-dried blood stains left. Looking down, Hella's fist is clenched so tightly that small trails of blood seep out.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Let go, Hella. This must hurt.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...Give the meds to someone else. I don't need them. These little scratches will heal in a few minutes.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Yeah... Yeah, I know.
She slowly pries open Hella's clenched fist. Fragments of a tracker are embedded in her palm, preventing the cuts from healing.
Korryn stays silent as she helps remove them.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...Aren't you gonna ask what this is?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Aren't you gonna ask how they found this place? Why I left, or why I'm here?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...You know everything. Why aren't you blaming me?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: It's all my fault... Those bastards blew up the town because of me... I led them here, and now you've all suffered...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: You left your Hypercubes back in the town. Another sandstorm will come again soon. What the hell are you gonna do...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Say something... Yell at me, hit me... it's all my fault!
Tears blur Hella's eyes from seeing the person beside her, but she feels a hand gently patting her head.
Then, a warm cup of milk is pressed into her hand.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Actually, I've got milk in my cup too.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Huh...?

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: I happened to see a little mouse who screamed for revenge, but who then just stared at the Hypercubes for ages before running off after drawing silly faces.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Where do you think you are? This is Tuco, a scammers' den; we saw right through your little tricks.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: As for why no one blew the lid off...

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: It's not every day we meet such a charming little girl. Of course we'd want her to stay a bit longer, right?

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Tuco's just a small town. There's nothing here to make you stay... If we just said "we like you and admire you," you'd have bolted ages ago, right?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Em... That's true...

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: So we had to rely on trickery. We're all deceiving each other. It's fifty-fifty, fair and square.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: But because of me... the whole town was destroyed... Even... even Mr. Wright is...

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: But you also saved us from the town. You rushed back again and again to retrieve things, even when your power couldn't keep up with how fast you were getting hurt. That's why your wounds haven't healed yet.
A cotton ball gently wipes the blood off Hella's hand. Then, a bandage is applied on the wound.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: In WhiteSands, you'll meet all sorts of people. To survive, you've got to stay clear-eyed and see them for who they are. So...
Korryn ties a crooked bow on Hella's hand and then ruffles her hair.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: We didn't trust the wrong person.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Maybe you're not strong enough now, and will make many mistakes... but that's okay. You have plenty of time. One day, you'll grow up, and become strong enough to face any challenge.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Don't rush, and don't feel sad about it.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Hella is the best girl in the world, the toughest little mouse. No one can say otherwise.
Hella lowers her head, finally unable to hold back her tears.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Sob... sob... sob... waaaah!
Regret, guilt, and indescribable bitterness... Uncontrollable emotions well up, spilling out as tears that wet her hands and drip into the glass of milk in front of her.
This time, Korryn doesn't try to stop Hella from crying. She gently strokes Hella's back, then helps her to stand up again.
Not far away, the Tuco folks gather to hold a "ceremony."
Wright's body is placed in a wooden boat. In WhiteSands, there are no fresh flowers, so people weave tumbleweed branches into wreaths and place them on boats accompanying the dead.
The frail man is covered in ash, wounds and burns. With the wreaths hiding these scars, his face looks unexpectedly peaceful.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Wright wasn't in the best shape and had to rely on his lock-picking skills to get by. Every time his enemies chased him, it nearly cost him his life. In the end, he couldn't take it anymore, so he stole those fancy clothes to wear.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: That's how it is in the WhiteSands. Resources are scarce, so everyone else is an enemy.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: But even Hypercubes won't necessarily keep you safe. Everyone has to keep fighting to survive... Even if you hadn't come, things would still turn out the same.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: But we're never afraid of that. We're only afraid of living unfreely, or dying with no one caring.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: He's already luckier than most people in WhiteSands to have lived happily to this age. He loved to joke about it himself, and surely wouldn't want you to be sad for him.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: He always liked you, and would definitely be happy to see you safe and sound.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Go on. Take a wreath and say goodbye to him.
People step forward one by one to whisper their farewells to Wright. There's no crying, only blessings.
The starlight spills from the sky, illuminating the sand and turning the ground into a sea of stars. The wooden boat drifts forward with the quicksand, entering the river of starlight.
Behind, Maggie starts playing her vihuela again. The melody, combined with the crowd's blessings, forms a unique rhythm.

Congratulations, for witnessing the most magnificent desert sunset. Congratulations, for keeping the most genuine smile in these times. Thank you. Your path will guide our way forward. Your soul will ignite hope for life in WhiteSands.
Thank you. We will keep telling your story, and bless your rebirth.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Thank you, for living so brilliantly.
Korryn gently wipes away Hella's tears and places more dried wreaths in her palm.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Now that you're one of us, want to say a blessing?
Wright's little boat sails toward WhiteSands, getting smaller and smaller amidst the music, before finally merging with the starlight.

The vast desert, the Milky Way, the simple blessings, and the Outlanders' singing... Hella stays silent for a long time. Before the boat completely disappears, she steps forward and scatters the dried tumbleweed in her hands toward the sea of stars.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Thanks for trusting me and protecting me. I don't know how to say goodbye in the Tuco way, but...
The sky begins to brighten, and dawn pierces through the darkness. Hella lifts her head, her tears not yet dry, but her gaze resolute.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: If someone bullies you, hit 'em back hard. I'll get revenge for you the Syndicate way.
Beside Hella, Korryn puts her hat back on and flashes a smile.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: I'll be looking forward to it, my Syndicate friend.
